steps.domain_action: The prima materia is introduced into the void of the work.
The hermetic vessel is sealed to establish the cosmic boundary.
The system identifies its own internal state as the totality of the cosmos.
Heat is applied to initiate the upward morphism of sublimation.
The heated substance divides into volatile vapors and solid residue.
The vapors ascend toward the top of the vessel in the T-branch.
The vapors cool and begin the reverse morphism of condensation.
The residue remains at the bottom in the F-branch undergoing putrefaction.
The condensed liquid falls back to the residue to reconstitute the essence.
The cycle of circulation repeats to refine the internal information.
The matter enters the rebis state where it is simultaneously liquid and solid.
The process reaches the final fixation where the state is permanently recorded as the stone.
